observations: Both final pages were displayed and read at 1350px. Page 1 explains issue identity, selection coverage, retained/excluded rights, guarantee distinctions and the report-scope table; page 2 explains engineering evidence and remaining work.

The opening now distinguishes German clause locations and explanations for excluded options from the selected German Option I terms. Excluded Option II locations are not represented as operative Option I prose.
Page 1 names BASF Finance issues and the German Bond Act. The separate initial and successor guarantee conditions remain distinct.
The report table and its qualifications fit together on page 1. The conflicting 195–209 range is clearly attributed to the supplement, while the listed notes remain 209–290.
The authoritative German auditor original and unqualified financial values/column order remain visible. No source qualification was removed by the wording repair.
The final LaTeX build reports no warning, undefined reference, overfull or underfull box. No clipping or overlapping content was visible.

Page 2 retains all 186 engineering tests, the unadjudicated original records, 25 review forms, incomplete continuous contract, and pending external acceptance. It does not claim legal accuracy or production readiness.

The actual TeX body diff from phase 007 to phase 013 was inspected. It changes references and explanations in the prose; no equation, conditional right, range, test result or remaining dependency was deleted.

reader_questions.question: Which rights survive and why could conflation matter?
reader_questions.answer: The selected change-of-control right survives exclusion of the scheduled put, and the dated/make-whole/clean-up issuer calls differ from the excluded interest-date, renminbi and transaction-trigger calls. Page 1 gives the distinct conditions rather than erasing a selected right.

reader_questions.question: Why does a successor guarantee condition remain?
reader_questions.answer: The initial BASF SE issuer excludes the initial guarantee used for BASF Finance issues, but a later issuer substitution remains subject to section 10(d). Page 1 explains the separate contingencies.

reader_questions.question: What does the report table establish?
reader_questions.answer: It identifies 92 expressly listed pages and their printed/physical pagination. The conflicting broader range, authoritative German auditor original, financial values and column order remain unresolved or unqualified.

reader_questions.question: What do the tests establish and what follows?
reader_questions.answer: They check deterministic engineering behaviour and source replay. Continuous German contract construction, source completeness, independent labels and unexposed evaluation remain the next development and acceptance tasks.
